title: Trainstorm Element (Unified)
description: The reconciled Trainstorm element: one flat, ID-keyed node that unifies course.schema (authoring), scene.schema (render), and course-primitives (substrate). A node is thin — it owns its SOURCE meaning and carries keyed references (facets) into the sub-models. Translations live in external locale packs keyed by element_id; visual/motion/interaction primitives live in registries; objectives live in the intent ontology. One agent owns each facet (single-writer). Containers (Course/Module/Section/Scene) and leaf elements (Head/Statement/…) are both nodes here, related by structure.parent_id.

element_id.description: Stable, opaque, durable identity — the single join key across the object graph, every locale pack, the registries, and the learner model. Never reused or edited. Recommended prefix convention, e.g. ele_… / sce_… / mod_…

source_hash.description: Hash of the content payload. Detects a real change of meaning (invalidating downstream renderings / translations) versus a node that merely moved. This is the cure for 'which version is this?'.

type.description: What this node IS. Containers and leaf elements share the array; parent/child is expressed via structure.parent_id.

content.description: The invariant meaning — SOURCE LOCALE ONLY. Do not embed other languages here; translations live in locales/<lang>.json keyed by element_id. (This is the fix for the AST009 drift.) Containers may omit text.

locale.description: BCP-47 tag of the source language.

structure.description: Object facet — the node's place in the graph. Owner: Content Architecture.

intent.description: Two distinct senses of intent, deliberately separated. Owner: L&D / Instructional Design.

rhetorical.description: What the element does on the page (from scene.schema). A lint rule may default this from `type` (e.g. Head→orient) — not enforced here so reuse stays legal.

teaches.description: objective_ids in the intent ontology this element serves (the pedagogical add).

expression.description: Form — KEYS into the expression registries (from scene.schema's primitive refs). Never embedded styles or translations. Owner: Brand + Localization.

content_role.description: Finer role of this element within its primitive (from course-primitives).

audience.description: Fit hooks for the responsive engine (the manifold add). Design-time targeting + adaptivity metadata; holds NO learner PII — that lives in the separate learner model. Owner: L&D Adaptivity.

variant_group.description: Group of interchangeable variants; the engine picks one per learner.

assessment.description: Assessment facet (from course-primitives.relationships). Present on interactive/assessment nodes.

narration.description: Voice facet (from scene.narration + course-primitives.speaker). Owner: Narration/Audio.

voice_text.description: Spoken variant of the on-screen text, source locale.

render.description: Render-target facet — inputs to the render agents (from scene.render + course-primitives.render). Downstream of expression.

governance.description: Provenance/authority — per element, not just per course. This is what ends the 'too much generated, which is current?' problem. Owner: Governance / Quality.

ext.description: Sanctioned extension point. New/experimental facets go here so they can accrete without a breaking schema change; promote to a first-class facet once stable.
